title: Transaction Illustration
contentTitle: STOCK INDEX, GOLD, BCO & SILVER LOCO LONDON TRANSACTIONS
formulaText: [ ( Selling Price – Buying Price ) x Contract Size x n Lot ] – [ ( Facility Fee + VAT ) x n Lot ]
keteranganLines: Contract Size (contract value): US$5 per point for stock index periodic rolling contracts, 100 troy ounces for Loco London gold daily rolling contracts, 5,000 troy ounces for Loco London silver daily rolling contracts, 1,000 barrels for Brent Crude Oil (BCO) periodic rolling contracts, and 100,000 for forex daily rolling spot contracts.
n Lot: n is the number of lots traded.
Facility Fee: US$15 per lot per side (buy or sell).
Rollover Facility: US$3/lot/night/side (buy or sell) for HKK; US$2/lot/night/side (buy or sell) for JPK; US$5/lot/night/side (buy or sell) for Gold, Silver, and BCO.
Total commission fee is US$30 for 1 lot settlement.
VAT (Value Added Tax) on Facility Fee: 11% of the commission fee, i.e. US$1.65/lot/side.
Total VAT is US$3.3 for 1 lot settlement.
If the transaction is settled more than one day (overnight), each lot will be charged an overnight/rollover fee plus 11% VAT on the overnight fee (see trading table).

ex1.title: Example 1 (HKK5U_BBJ)
ex1.p1: An investor takes a position in HKK5U_BBJ at 25,000 for 2 lots (Open Buy 2 lots), expecting the price to move higher. During the day session the price rises to 25,400 and they liquidate all positions at 25,300 (Closed Sell 2 lots).

ex2.title: Example 2 (JPK5U_BBJ)
ex2.p1: An investor analyzes that JPK5U_BBJ will decline and immediately takes a sell position at 49,850 for 2 lots. Two days later, the investor closes the position when the price is at 49,650.
ex2.f1: P/L = [(Selling Price - Buying Price) x Contract Size x n Lot] - [(Fee US$30 + VAT) x n Lot]
ex2.f3: P/L = (200 points x US$5 x 2 lots) - US$66.6
ex2.result: Because the trade is held overnight, an overnight (rollover) fee + VAT is charged: [(US$2 + US$0.22) x 2 lots x 2 nights] = US$8.88, so net profit is: P/L = US$1,933.4 - US$8.88 = US$1,924.52

ex3.title: Example 3 (XULF)
ex3.p1: An investor predicts Loco London gold is in an uptrend and plans to take a buy position. They buy 2 lots at $4,275.30 / troy ounce. However, the price drops to $4,260.65 / troy ounce and they must liquidate 1 lot at $4,265.30 / troy ounce. On the next day, they liquidate the remaining lot when the price is at $4,290.20 / troy ounce.
ex3.d1f1: P/L = [US$(4,265.30 - 4,275.30) / troy ounce x 100 troy ounces x 1 lot] - [US$(30 + 3.3) x 1 lot]
ex3.rollover: Because the trade is held more than 1 day, an overnight (rollover) fee + VAT is charged: [(US$5 + US$0.55) x 1 lot x 1 night] = US$5.55

ex4.title: Example 4 (XAGF)
ex4.p1: An investor expects Loco London silver to rise, so they take a buy position in XAGF at $61,175 / troy ounce for 1 lot. They liquidate the position at $61,200. The investor’s profit is:
ex4.f1: P/L = [ ( Selling Price – Buying Price ) x Contract Size x n Lot ] - [ ( Facility Fee + VAT ) x n Lot ]
ex4.f2: P/L = [ ( US$61,200 / troy ounce – US$61,175 / troy ounce ) x 5,000 troy ounces x 1 lot ] – [ ( US$30 + US$3.3 ) x 1 lot ]
ex4.f3: P/L = ( 0.025 / troy ounce x 5,000 / troy ounce x 1 lot ) – ( US$33.3 )
ex4.af1: P/L = [ ( Selling Price – Buying Price ) x Contract Size x n Lot ] - [ ( Facility Fee + VAT ) x n Lot ]
ex4.af2: P/L = [ ( US$61,155 / troy ounce – US$61,175 / troy ounce ) x 5,000 troy ounces x 1 lot ] – [ ( US$30 + US$3.3 ) x 1 lot ]
ex4.af3: P/L = ( -0.020 / troy ounce x 5,000 / troy ounce x 1 lot ) – ( US$33.3 )

forex.directFormula: P / L = [(Selling Price-Buying Price) x Contract Size x n Lots] – [(Facility Fee + VAT) x n Lot]
forex.indirectFormula: P / L = (Selling Price-Purchase Price) / Liquidation Price x Contract Size x Number of Lots

ex1.p1: An investor predicts EUR/USD spot will rise, then takes a buy position at 1.1530 for 2 lots. Shortly after, the investor liquidates at 1.1540 for 2 lots (clear position). The result is:
ex1.f1: P/L = [(Selling Price – Buying Price) x Contract Size x n Lot] – [(Facility Fee + VAT) x n Lot]
ex1.result: Net profit: Rp 1,334,000.00 (fixed rate US$1 = Rp 10,000.00)
ex1.altHeading: However, if the position is liquidated at 1.1525, then:
ex1.altResult: P/L = -US$166.6 — Net loss: -Rp 1,666,000.00 (fixed rate US$1 = Rp 10,000.00)

ex2.title: Example 2: UJ1010_BBJ (Daytrade)
ex2.p1: An investor predicts USD/JPY spot will fall, then takes a sell position on UJ1010_BBJ at 152.20 for 1 lot. A few hours later, the investor liquidates at 152.12. The calculation is:
ex2.result: P/L = US$19.29 — Profit: Rp 192,900.00 (fixed rate US$1 = Rp 10,000.00)
ex2.altHeading: But if USD/JPY is at 152.27 and liquidated at the same price, then:
ex2.altResult: P/L = -US$79.27 — Net loss: -Rp 792,700.00 (fixed rate US$1 = Rp 10,000.00)
